ordered_commits.name: target scaffold and boundary
steps: add internal library and test targets only
add boundary check and negative fixtures first
add non-authoritative CURRENT.md
prove no-content scaffold parity
prove isolated Validation build/link path without changing pinned runner
migrate historical validator to recorded Git blobs and prove self-test plus injected historical-lock mismatch rejection before pinned edit
make locked historical revision available before Architecture CI check.sh with fetch-depth: 0 or deterministic explicit fetch; classify missing object as infrastructure failure

ordered_commits.name: 2A independent study schemas and tests
steps: move the two study schema files and validation-specific tests without Codable or privacy-rule drift
keep old evaluator wrapper green

ordered_commits.name: 2B parallel Core observation and Validation evaluator
steps: introduce narrow immutable Core production-fact snapshot and Core-only construction errors alongside old diagnostic implementation
introduce Validation A/B1/B2, fixed-bank, selected-set evaluator and bank-specific errors
reuse production knowledge/observation semantics
keep old wrapper green

ordered_commits.name: 2C same-tree old/new parity
steps: compare identical states and selected sets
prove exact A/B1/B2 masks, positions, fingerprints, coverage, quantiles, miss outputs, counterfactuals, and invalid-input rejection
prove observation side-effect freedom
do not switch wrapper before pass

ordered_commits.name: 2D wrapper and imports switch
steps: require historical validator and 2C parity green
link Validation plus Core in same package/Swift 6/optimization/warnings context
preserve paths, flags, exits, schemas, artifacts
prove no-cache build
retain old Core evaluator temporarily as parity reference

ordered_commits.name: 2E remove old Core experiment implementation
steps: remove old Core banks, fixed-bank evaluation, bank errors, selectionOverride
retain narrow Core snapshot and construction errors
move or update tests by owner
prove no stale Core bank callers and integrated strict checks/parity green

ordered_commits.name: assessment, causal, and longitudinal runners
steps: move shared synthetic/replay/forensic/manifest/report/provenance/metric mechanics
retain thin compatible command/file adapters and 2D wrapper/import/link integration
prove clean build without cached Core or Validation modules
compare locked old/new outputs before deleting duplicates

ordered_commits.name: POS and cross-format helpers
steps: move reusable Swift POS evaluation and cross-format comparison mechanics needing Core only
retain real PDFKit/Web/document-loading cross-format integration fixture in LeafReaderAppTests
App tests may call shared Validation comparison helper but Validation never depends on App
keep lexical identity, occurrence accounting, inventory, parsing, and objectives in Core
retain Python analysis role
use fresh POS development material for new scoring/tuning; allow read-only historical validation

ordered_commits.name: enforcement, documentation, and stop
steps: wire boundary and validation checks into check.sh
verify paths, historical baseline Git blobs, extracted-generator provenance, and report parity
document only the implemented boundary
publish checkpoint and stop without model redesign; fresh reservation follows extraction checkpoint
